name: Mizuki
source:
A boy who is the main character of this story.
He is cheerful and emotional, which clearly shows his feelings.
He was helped by the prince when dying on the street, and entered a royal palace as a servant.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092288.html]DLsite English[/url]]
